description: Converts a Chinese lunar calendar date (农历 / 阴历: lunar year, month, day, leap month) to the Western (Gregorian) date. Covers questions like 'when is my lunar birthday this year', 'when is the 15th of the 8th lunar month in 2027', 'Mid-Autumn Festival date', '农历八月十五是哪天'.

is_leap_month.description: True for a leap (intercalary) month. Default false.

lunar_year.description: Lunar year, named by the Western year in which it begins, e.g. 2027.

name: convert_lunar_date
title: Lunar date to Western date
